facts.text: CoboltLaser is a diode-pumped laser and supports only TriggerMode.SOFTWARE
The constructor sends sn?, @cobas 0 to disable autostart and gmlp? to read the maximum power
The serial connection is 115200 baud, 8 data bits, one stop bit and no parity by default
get_status queries l?, p?, pa?, f? and hrs? and returns the five replies with their labels
clearFault sends cf and returns get_status()
initialize sends @cobasdr 0 (leave direct-control mode) and @cob1 (force autostart)
_do_enable sends l1 and returns False unless get_is_on() then reports emission on
get_is_on sends l? and treats the reply b'1' as emission on
_get_power_mw returns 0.0 while emission is off, otherwise reads pa? in W and returns 1000 times it
_set_power_mw writes @cobasp with the power in W to four decimals and accepts any non-negative value
_do_set_power multiplies the fraction by the head maximum and _do_get_power divides by it
LightSource.power is the fraction of maximum power in the [0, 1] interval and its setter clips to it
